issue.title: test_a_second_pass_over_the_same_documents_is_idempotent fails under the full parallel test-scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Order-dependent flake in tests/sdd/test_artifact_link_derivation.py observed during epic sase-z4.6.5 verification: the node fails only inside the full parallel just test-scoped run and passes in isolation on both the epic branch and clean origin/master.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Reported by epic phase bead sase-z4.6.5.1 (note #3, agent sase-z4.6.5.1--3, 2026-09-10) while
verifying the admission-authority phase of epic sase-z4.6.5, and routed here by the sase-z4.6.5
land agent.

Observations (2026-09-10, workspace clone of sase master around HEAD 3260f6a42):

- FAIL: only under the full `just test-scoped` parallel lane (xdist), as 1 of 8 failures in
  that run. The other 7 were the deterministic model-resolution failures now corroborated on
  task sase-q4, which are a different defect.
- PASS: immediately in isolation on the same tree, and also in isolation on clean
  origin/master (the reporter confirmed both by re-running the single node after the lane
  finished, and separately under `git stash -u`).

Fail rate: 1 of 1 full-lane runs observed; 0 of 2 isolated runs. Serial reproduction: not
reproduced serially. Classified by the reporter as an order-dependent, full-parallel-lane-only
flake rather than a regression from the admission-authority phase -- that phase's diff touches
runner-slot admission, agent-scan wire records, and agent metadata propagation, not artifact-link
derivation.

Land-agent provenance: this record relays the phase agent's observations. I did not independently
re-run the node; the sase_core_rs extension is not built in this landing workspace, so no pytest
lane was available to me.

Suggested first step for whoever works this: the sibling artifact-link derivation suites write
into shared per-project link state, so the likely shape is cross-test leakage of derived link
state or of a derivation cache rather than anything specific to the idempotence assertion.

payload.entry:
RELATED BEADS (recorded as a note because `sase artifact link add` is currently failing on this host -- the hidden plans clone has 4 stranded 'persist link events' commits; reported on active epic sase-yy.8):
- sase-ct: the retired flake umbrella for the full-parallel-lane/pass-in-isolation class. This node-specific bead was filed instead of a +1 because sase-ct's close reason explicitly forbids corroboration.
- sase-q4: seven deterministic model-resolution failures were observed in the same `just test-scoped` run, but they are a distinct defect -- those fail deterministically and serially, this node passes on rerun.
Whoever works this should add both typed related links once artifact-link publication is healthy.
